blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Marcos on Thursday highlighted the easing of foreign ownership restrictions in certain industries as he sought to attract international investors to the Philippines. Marcos said his administration had relaxed investment restrictions and streamlined business procedures in response to concerns raised by prospective investors. “We have tried to streamline many of the processes for business to come in, and to make it easier for businesses,” Marcos said during an onstage discussion with Forbes Media chair and editor in chief Steve Forbes during the 24th Forbes Global CEO Conference at the Shangri-La Hotel in Singapore.
